description: User direction 2026-11-20 (answering the fz-mue.16 page, relayed by Elixir Parity): neg_integer, non_neg_integer and pos_integer resolve to integer for now, like byte, and this ticket goes at the END of the parity epic. title: Integer range types: byte, char, neg_integer, non_neg_integer and pos_integer are exact, as in Elixir
